_about: Public-domain Jacob Boehme (Behmen, 1575-1624, Lutheran mystic of Görlitz) in English for the Word Hoard: the Dialogues on the Supersensual Life ed. Bernard Holland (1901) from CCEL, the four-volume Works with figures left by William Law (1764-1781), seventeenth-century English printings, most of them John Sparrow's translations (the Threefold Life, Forty Questions, Signatura Rerum, Aurora, the Election of Grace, Mysterium Magnum, the Way to Christ), the Way to Christ (1894), the Epistles (1886) and the Six Theosophic Points tr. John Rolleston Earle (1919), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 25 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Translators recorded per item where the title page names one; every printing dated or catalogued before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
